collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HEALING, PSYCHOLOGY AND MEDICINE (HEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Healers, herbs, teas, poultices, mushrooms, potions, island magic, listening, breathing, routines and rest. Care for the body and care for the mind, with every kind of healing treated with equal respect. Treatments can help, help a little, do nothing or have side effects. Nobody has to be cured, nobody is mocked, and the villager always decides.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 4-10 and a healer or elder)

collection.description: A healer is about to lift a big splinter from a child's palm: let the child say when, or do it on two.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has a large splinter in (subject.his/her) palm. (subject.He/she) is not crying, but only because (subject.he/she) has decided not to, and that decision is under a lot of strain. (friend) has a small, clean thorn for lifting it out. "I'll do it on three," says (friend). "One..."

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "WAIT," says (subject). "Can I say when?" (friend) nods. (subject) takes a deep breath. And another. And another. "Now?" asks (friend). "Not yet." Eventually (subject) says, very quietly, "Now," and squeezes (subject.his/her) eyes shut. It's out before (subject.he/she) opens them. "That's it?" (subject.he/she) says, outraged. "I was ready for much worse."

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) does it on two. The splinter's out before (subject) knows it. There's a moment of wobbling lip. Then (subject) frowns. "You said THREE." "I did," says (friend). "I'm sorry. Some people find it easier that way, but I should have asked you first." (subject) considers this. "Next time," (subject.he/she) says, "ask." "I will," says (friend), and means it.
